metadata.description: German adolescent screening instrument for gaming-disorder symptoms based on ICD-11 concepts.
metadata.intended_use: Research screening among adolescents with frequent gaming; not a standalone clinical diagnosis.
metadata.name_origin: Gaming Disorder Scale for Adolescents, abbreviated GADIS-A.
metadata.development_history: Validated in German frequent-gamer samples aged 10-17 in an ICD-11-oriented study.
metadata.measurement_rationale: The instrument targets impaired control and clinically relevant functional impairment associated with gaming.
metadata.interpretation_notes: ICD-11 gaming disorder concepts are not interchangeable with DSM-5 internet-gaming-disorder criteria; use the exact manual and population evidence.

versions.display_name: Gaming Disorder Scale for Adolescents Deutsch (link-only)
versions.source_citation: Paschke et al. (2020). Psychometric properties of the Gaming Disorder Scale for Adolescents.

source_documents.title: German Gaming Disorder Scale for Adolescents validation
source_documents.license_name: Metadata reference; exact reuse terms require source review
source_documents.permission_basis: Only bibliographic and discovery metadata is stored. Questionnaire wording and forms are not included until exact edition, language, and reuse terms are verified.
